import os, sys, json, time

import numpy as np
import mujoco
import rcb_dtb
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from PIL import Image

class Controller:
    def __init__(self,s):
        self.s=s; self.m=s.model; self.k=mujoco.MjData(self.m)
        self.bid=self.m.body('palmworld').id
        self.hid=self.m.body('palmleft_hand_C_MC').id
        self.qi=s._jq; self.vi=s._jv
        self.jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv)); self.jr=np.zeros_like(self.jp)
    def pose(self):
        return self.s.data.xpos[self.bid].copy(),self.s.data.xmat[self.bid].reshape(3,3).copy()
    def ik(self,p,R,q=None, n=80):
        q=self.s.state()['q'].copy() if q is None else q.copy()
        self.k.qpos[:]=self.s.data.qpos
        for _ in range(n):
            self.k.qpos[self.qi]=q
            mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.m,self.k); mujoco.mj_comPos(self.m,self.k)
            dp=p-self.k.xpos[self.bid]
            dr=Rot.from_matrix(R@self.k.xmat[self.bid].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()
            e=np.r_[dp,dr*.15]
            if np.linalg.norm(e)<1e-6:break
            mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,self.k,self.jp,self.jr,self.bid)
            J=np.vstack([self.jp[:,self.vi[:7]],self.jr[:,self.vi[:7]]*.15])
            dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-6,e)
            q[:7]=np.clip(q[:7]+dq*np.minimum(1,.15/(np.max(np.abs(dq))+1e-12)),self.s.lower[:7]+.001,self.s.upper[:7]-.001)
        return q
    def move(self,p,R,hand=None,steps=120):
        p0,R0=self.pose(); rv=Rot.from_matrix(R@R0.T).as_rotvec(); q=self.s.targets.copy(); h0=q[7:].copy()
        for i in range(steps):
            a=(i+1)/steps; a=a*a*(3-2*a)
            q=self.ik(p0+(p-p0)*a,Rot.from_rotvec(rv*a).as_matrix()@R0,q,n=12)
            if hand is not None:q[7:]=h0+(hand-h0)*a
            self.s.step(q)
    def hold(self,n=120):
        for _ in range(n): self.s.step(self.s.targets)
    def close(self,h,n=120):
        q0=self.s.targets.copy()
        for i in range(n):
            q=q0.copy(); q[7:]=q0[7:]+(h-q0[7:])*min((i+1)/n,1)
            self.s.step(q)
    def snap(self,name):
        Image.fromarray(self.s.render_grid(size=(640,480))).save('/app/output/'+name+'.png')
    def status(self,label):
        st=self.s.state(); print(label,self.s.progress(),'obj',np.round(st['object_pos'],4),'palm',np.round(st['palm_pos'],4),flush=True)
        for i in range(self.s.data.ncon):
            c=self.s.data.contact[i]; b=self.m.geom_bodyid[[c.geom1,c.geom2]]
            if self.s._obj in b: print('contact',self.m.geom(c.geom1).name,self.m.geom(c.geom2).name,round(c.dist,4),flush=True)

def handclose(mcp=.9,pip=1.3,dip=1.,thumb=(1.25,.1,.7,0,1.2)):
    h=np.zeros(22);h[:5]=thumb
    for i in [5,9,13,18]:h[i:i+4]=[mcp,0,pip,dip]
    h[17]=.1
    return h

def downR(yaw=0):
    HC=np.array([[0,1,0],[0,0,-1],[-1,0,0.]])
    return Rot.from_rotvec([0,0,yaw]).as_matrix()@HC@Rot.from_euler('z',75,degrees=True).as_matrix()

def trial(x=.08,y=.22,z=.602,mcp=.9,pip=1.3,dip=1.,yaw=0):
    s=rcb_dtb.Session();c=Controller(s);s.record_start()
    R=downR(yaw)
    c.move(np.array([x,y,.72]),R,steps=100)
    c.move(np.array([x,y,z]),R,steps=150)
    c.hold(60);c.status('approach');c.snap('approach')
    c.close(handclose(mcp,pip,dip),120);c.hold(60);c.status('closed');c.snap('closed')
    c.move(np.array([x,y,z+.15]),R,steps=180);c.hold(120);c.status('lift');c.snap('lift')
    A=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(A,'/app/output/trial.npz')
    return s,c,A
if __name__=='__main__':
    import argparse
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--x',type=float,default=.08);ap.add_argument('--y',type=float,default=.22);ap.add_argument('--z',type=float,default=.602);ap.add_argument('--mcp',type=float,default=.9);ap.add_argument('--pip',type=float,default=1.3);ap.add_argument('--dip',type=float,default=1);ap.add_argument('--yaw',type=float,default=0)
    args=vars(ap.parse_args());trial(**args)
